take_homes: Access is not use. A login is not uptake, like the driver app where half the depots still use paper.
Do not start from the tool. Ask the person how they do the job today and what would make them switch.
Pick one person and ask one question before building anything.

monday.move: Ask one depot manager how he builds the weekly shift report today, and what is annoying about it. Only that, with no AI demo.
